theorem QOU.Mathlib.FibrationExactness.Prod.homotopyGroupMap_fst_eq_const_iff {B : Type uB} [TopologicalSpace B] {N : Type uN} {F : Type uF} [TopologicalSpace F] {w : B × F} {b : B} (he : w.1 = b) (q : HomotopyGroup N (B × F) w) :
HomotopyGroupFunctor.homotopyGroupMap ContinuousMap.fst he q = ⟦GenLoop.const⟧ ↔ ∃ (r : HomotopyGroup N ↑(Fibre ContinuousMap.fst b) ⟨w, he⟩), HomotopyGroupFunctor.homotopyGroupMap (fibreIncl ContinuousMap.fst b) ⋯ r = q

theorem QOU.Mathlib.FibrationExactness.pi_range_eq_ker {E : Type uE} {B : Type uB} [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace B] {n : ℕ} (p : C(E, B)) {e : E} {b : B} (he : p e = b) (hlift : HomotopyLifting.HasHomotopyLiftingPropertyRel p (Fin (n + 1) → ↑unitInterval) (Cube.boundary (Fin (n + 1)))) :
(HomotopyGroupFunctor.homotopyGroupHom (fibreIncl p b) ⋯).range = (HomotopyGroupFunctor.homotopyGroupHom p he).ker

theorem QOU.Mathlib.FibrationExactness.pi_eq_homotopyGroup (m : ℕ) (X : Type u_1) [TopologicalSpace X] (x : X) :
HomotopyGroup.Pi m X x = HomotopyGroup (Fin m) X x

theorem QOU.Mathlib.FibrationExactness.injective_homotopyGroupHom_of_subsingleton_fibre {E : Type uE} {B : Type uB} [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace B] {N : Type uN} [DecidableEq N] [Nonempty N] (p : C(E, B)) {e : E} {b : B} (he : p e = b) (hlift : HomotopyLifting.HasHomotopyLiftingPropertyRel p (N → ↑unitInterval) (Cube.boundary N)) [Subsingleton (HomotopyGroup N ↑(Fibre p b) ⟨e, he⟩)] :
Function.Injective ⇑(HomotopyGroupFunctor.homotopyGroupHom p he)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.FibrationExactness.range_homotopyGroupHom_eq_ker {E : Type uE} {B : Type uB} [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace B] {N : Type uN} [DecidableEq N] [Nonempty N] (p : C(E, B)) {e : E} {b : B} (he : p e = b) (hlift : HomotopyLifting.HasHomotopyLiftingPropertyRel p (N → ↑unitInterval) (Cube.boundary N)) :
(HomotopyGroupFunctor.homotopyGroupHom (fibreIncl p b) ⋯).range = (HomotopyGroupFunctor.homotopyGroupHom p he).ker

theorem QOU.Mathlib.FibrationExactness.homotopyGroupMap_eq_const_iff {E : Type uE} {B : Type uB} [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace B] {N : Type uN} (p : C(E, B)) {e : E} {b : B} (he : p e = b) (hlift : HomotopyLifting.HasHomotopyLiftingPropertyRel p (N → ↑unitInterval) (Cube.boundary N)) (q : HomotopyGroup N E e) :
HomotopyGroupFunctor.homotopyGroupMap p he q = ⟦GenLoop.const⟧ ↔ ∃ (r : HomotopyGroup N ↑(Fibre p b) ⟨e, he⟩), HomotopyGroupFunctor.homotopyGroupMap (fibreIncl p b) ⋯ r = q

theorem QOU.Mathlib.FibrationExactness.exists_preimage_of_map_eq_const {E : Type uE} {B : Type uB} [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace B] {N : Type uN} (p : C(E, B)) {e : E} {b : B} (he : p e = b) (hlift : HomotopyLifting.HasHomotopyLiftingPropertyRel p (N → ↑unitInterval) (Cube.boundary N)) (g : ↑(GenLoop N E e)) (h : ⟦HomotopyGroupFunctor.genLoopMap p he g⟧ = ⟦GenLoop.const⟧) :
∃ (r : HomotopyGroup N ↑(Fibre p b) ⟨e, he⟩), HomotopyGroupFunctor.homotopyGroupMap (fibreIncl p b) ⋯ r = ⟦g⟧

theorem QOU.Mathlib.FibrationExactness.fibre_comp_eq_const {E : Type uE} {B : Type uB} [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace B] {N : Type uN} (p : C(E, B)) {e : E} {b : B} (he : p e = b) (r : HomotopyGroup N ↑(Fibre p b) ⟨e, he⟩) :
HomotopyGroupFunctor.homotopyGroupMap p he (HomotopyGroupFunctor.homotopyGroupMap (fibreIncl p b) ⋯ r) = ⟦GenLoop.const⟧

theorem QOU.Mathlib.FibrationExactness.comp_fibreIncl {E : Type uE} {B : Type uB} [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace B] (p : C(E, B)) (b : B) :
p.comp (fibreIncl p b) = ContinuousMap.const (↑(Fibre p b)) b

theorem QOU.Mathlib.FibrationExactness.fibreIncl_apply {E : Type uE} {B : Type uB} [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace B] {p : C(E, B)} {b : B} (w : ↑(Fibre p b)) :
(fibreIncl p b) w = ↑w

def QOU.Mathlib.FibrationExactness.fibreIncl {E : Type uE} {B : Type uB} [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace B] (p : C(E, B)) (b : B) :
C(↑(Fibre p b), E)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.FibrationExactness.mem_fibre {E : Type uE} {B : Type uB} [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace B] {p : C(E, B)} {b : B} {w : E} :
w ∈ Fibre p b ↔ p w = b

def QOU.Mathlib.FibrationExactness.Fibre {E : Type uE} {B : Type uB} [TopologicalSpace E] [TopologicalSpace B] (p : C(E, B)) (b : B) :
Set E
